setting.Lantern Route: A gentle evening bus route with rounded cottages, street lanterns, a park path, a quiet depot, and a starry sky overhead
setting.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle night-route colors, and no readable text

style: Warm polished 3D children's animation illustration, bright friendly lighting, soft rounded forms, true 4:3 landscape single continuous scene. NO text, letters, numbers, badges, logos, watermarks, panels, collage, grid, comic layout, contact sheet, or multi-panel. Vehicles have NO arms, hands, or human limbs. Leave the bottom 25-30% of the frame as soft uncluttered ground/space so a narration panel can overlay later; keep all important subjects above the lower quarter.
continuityRules: Nova keeps the same blueberry body, silver trim, cream roof stripe, lavender windshield eyes, six matching wheels, and soft roof lanterns on every page.
Nova and every vehicle have no human-like arms or hands.
Twinkle remains a tiny pearly white and lavender car with teal eyes and a gold star outline on the hood.
The gold star sticker is missing on Pages 4-9, found on Page 10, and back on Twinkle from Page 11 onward.
The calm last-stop depot appears on Pages 13-15 with warm porch lights.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, starry twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.
